preparation.protocol: All layers trainable, all 24 letters, all 1800 added M rows training-only. Ten epochs, LR 0.0001, seed 42, otherwise trainer defaults. Initial weights eligible at epoch 0; selected only by historical validation macro F1 then loss. Tests evaluated after selection.
preparation.limitations: Diagnostic only. Historical test is development-known; signer independence unverified. One seed and one predefined configuration, not a controlled multi-seed causal comparison. No new signer-independent or live-camera evidence.
